title: Dell security advisory (AV26-1134)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1134 Date: November 9, 2026 As of November 2, 2026, Dell is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products: Alienware Command Center (AWCC) Prior to 6.14.54.0 Wyse Management Suite Prior to 2609.0.0.155 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available. DSA-2026-405: Security Update for Dell Wyse Management Suite (WMS) for Multiple Vulnerabilities DSA-2026-429: Security Update for Dell Alienware Command Center 6.x for Multiple Vulnerabilities Security Advisories, Notices and Resources Article Link: Dell security advisory (AV26-1134) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
